contract: Read the named sidx or tfra box at its manifest offset and length. The reference opens the same preloaded movie with +noparse+nofillin.

For sidx, use a fresh backward seek per authored target and read one packet. Kind 3 compares the track ID, indexed byte range, presentation ticks in the fixture's media timescale, and whether the seek lands within the segment range. The candidate expects a direct media reference.

For tfra, use use_mfra_for=dts and read the first packet of the named track in each authored fragment range. Kind 3 compares the track ID, the fragment start from that declared range, and first-packet decode ticks against the tfra time. The manifest holds the fragment ranges independently of the candidate parser.
The cases carry track ID, work quantum and ordered triples of byte start, exclusive end and timestamp after the index extent. Kind 7 marks completion and kind 8 refusal.
